Abernathy Professor of Business Administration William J. Abernathy Professor of Business Administration Read more Tom Nicholas is William J. Abernathy Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School. He is British and holds a doctorate from Oxford University. His research focuses on the history of entrepreneurship, innovation and finance. His book ( VC: An American History ), examines the historical roots of the development of the venture capital industry in the United States.
